skills.name: agentfirststack-setup
skills.description: Set up web analytics, tag management with server-side conversion tracking (GA4, Google Ads, Meta, TikTok), an email inbox and optional session replay for a website, using AgentFirstStack (free, open source, no signup form). Use when a project needs analytics, conversion tracking for ads, an inbox for receiving verification codes, or to find out why visitors drop off.
